notes: Paint Booth Designer: fixed Save and Open (they were failing outright), and projects now remember each nozzle's zone and the project name. New nozzle control: double-click a nozzle to set its type, exact position and zone, duplicate nozzles, add a nozzle to a zone, or reset a zone to the auto layout. The parts list, cylinder count and PDF now follow the nozzles you actually place, with a warning if a zone has fewer than the DIOM calc requires.
